name: design-guide
prompt: The attached images are STYLE references only (classic Korean MMORPG pixel art). For more of that style, browse these two games and study their character sprites: 바람의나라: 연 https://baramy.nexon.com/ and 도깨비의세계 https://dokkaebi.kakaogames.com/preregister/ . Learn from them: thick 1px dark outlines, dithered shading, saturated but limited palette, about 3 to 3.5 heads tall with a large head and voluminous hair, slight 3/4 top-down view, light coming from the upper left. Then draw a NEW original character (not a copy of any reference): a young court painter (도화서 화원) of a Joseon-fantasy world, the company's head designer, 29 years old, French - light chestnut-brown wavy hair tied up in a small topknot with a black horsehair headband (망건), NO hat, NO glasses, fair skin, two clearly visible dark eyes, a relaxed faint smile, a thin ink brush tucked behind his right ear (dark red-brown handle sticking out past the hair, white bristle tip). Clothing: a periwinkle-blue dopo robe (#4b5f9e) with a plum-purple belt cord (#5b3a63) tied at the waist with two hanging tails, over a white hanbok, white pants, black flat shoes. In his left hand he holds a small rectangular cream sketchbook (화첩) with a dark brown spine flat against his chest; his right hand hangs loosely. Deliver him as a WALK-CYCLE SPRITE SHEET, not a single picture: a grid of 4 rows x 4 columns. Rows top to bottom = facing south (toward viewer), west, east, north (back). Columns left to right = standing, left foot forward, standing, right foot forward. Each cell is exactly 32x48 logical pixels, so the whole sheet is 128x192 logical pixels. Inside every cell the character occupies at most 30x46 - leave a fully empty 1-pixel margin on all four sides of every cell. Anchor rule for all 16 cells: the soles of the planted feet sit on the same row (row 46 of the cell, counting from 0, i.e. one pixel above the cell bottom) and the torso is centered on the same vertical axis (column 16); the head may bob up 1 pixel while walking but the feet baseline never moves. The sketchbook stays in the left hand in every direction (visible on his left side when facing west or east, hidden behind the body when facing north). Flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF) everywhere, no drop shadow, no text, no grid lines, no border. Render the 128x192 pixel art crisply, then upscale exactly 8x with nearest-neighbor so every logical pixel is a sharp 8x8 block on a 1024x1536 PNG, and give me that PNG to download.
